Sandbox_CJSFirearmAimingOverhaul_Maximum: Highest distance-only aim-time multiplier, reached after the configured number of tiles beyond effective-sight range. If effective sight exceeds physical range, the reciprocal curve speeds acquisition instead. Recoverable condition penalties can add more stabilization work. Default: 4.0.
Sandbox_CJSFirearmAimingOverhaul_CurveEx: Controls how quickly extra aim time ramps up beyond effective-sight range. Higher values keep the increase gentler near sight range and steeper near the full-penalty distance. Default: 1.5.
Sandbox_CJSFirearmAimingOverhaul_FullPen: Absolute sight-to-target distance required to reach the maximum slowdown, or absolute sight surplus required to reach its reciprocal speed bonus. Default: 10.
